content.content: 1. License: no element of the dependent contradicts any prerequisite. Fail on any contradicting element — name the element. 2. The verb list names exactly the verbs the help surface lists, and each install route the README attributes to the release is one the release produces. Fail on any extra, missing or misdescribed verb, or on a release route the README gets wrong — name it.
content.rationale: The README is prose answering to prose: a read-through for claims that contradict the product, the help surface, or the release's install routes it points at is the whole applicable check. The release prerequisite is an artifact read as prose here, so its cell is the matrix default — the gate plus a flag to extend the matrix.
